Semantic Overlap Summarization (SOS) is a novel and relatively under-explored seq-to-seq task. It refers to the process of generating a summary of common information from multiple alternative narratives originating from various sources.
outputs: semantic overlap summaries (common information summaries) generated from multiple alternative narratives
overlap summaries containing common information from multiple alternative narratives

Rate each generated summary on a 1–5 Likert scale for Coherence, Fluency, Consistency, and Relevance.

Coherence: It represents the collective quality of all sentences... Fluency: It represents the quality of individual sentences... Relevance: It checks whether the important overlapping content from the source documents has been selected... Consistency: A factually consistent overlap summary should contain only statements that are there in both the input documents.
